summary: Two Ethereum wallets lost a combined 187046 dollars after malicious token approvals signed in 2024 remained active. One wallet lost 124563 dollars in SYN and another lost 62489 dollars in USDC after assets later arrived in the affected wallets.
user_mistake: left previously signed malicious token approvals active
prevention: Revoke token approvals after completing interactions with unfamiliar applications / Review existing approvals before transferring new assets into a previously used wallet
